title: The Zariski torsor bijection sends the fibre over one to the boundary of one
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small Zariski site $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-zariski-site], with cohomology $H^p(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},-)$ and the long exact cohomology sequence of a short exact sequence as in [def-sc-topological-abelian-cohomology]. Write $\mathbf Z_X$ for the constant sheaf with value $\mathbf Z$ and $1\in H^0(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},\mathbf Z_X)$ for its unit section. Let $0\to G\to E\xrightarrow{p}\mathbf Z_X\to0$ be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$, let $T_E=p^{-1}(1)\subseteq E$ be its fibre over $1$ (the subsheaf of local sections of $E$ mapped by $p$ to the restriction of $1$), with $G$ acting by translation, and let $\delta_E:H^0(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},\mathbf Z_X)\to H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G)$ be the boundary map of its long exact sequence. Then $T_E$ is a $G$-torsor on $X_{\mathrm{Zar}}$ [def-sc-gm-torsor], and the canonical bijection $H^1(X_{\mathrm{Zar}},G)\cong\{\text{isomorphism classes of }G\text{-torsors}\}$ of [lem-sc-torsor-h1] (Zariski case) matches the class of $T_E$ with $\delta_E(1)$.

source.place: Cohomology, Lemma 02FQ (cohomology-lemma-torsors-h1, cohomology.tex line 268), proof, first paragraph: the class of a torsor is defined as the boundary of $1$ of the pushout extension; this node records that the canonical bijection of lem-sc-torsor-h1 is this one
